implementation_issues.title: [Items][P3] Implement guarded Normalium Z / Tackle action effects
implementation_issues.scope: Implement only held Normalium Z + actual active Tackle -> 100-power Physical Normal Breakneck Blitz under docs/design/z-moves.md. No public command registration yet.
criteria: Validate fresh canonical owned party/current Fusion, current conscious human actor and actual active move/positive PP, matching SQL/runtime reusable held crystal, supported Wild/Trainer/PvP singles/doubles and legal target. Reject eggs, box/foreign/stale/nickname/Transform/Imposter/Mega/Primal/Ultra/Dynamax and bag-only cases.

One bound reservation/use per team, independent opponent; bind battle/turn/controller/actor/owned ID/source move/target/crystal. Invalid input queues nothing; repeats cannot overwrite/duplicate or advance turns. Other crystals/moves/status Z remain rejected.

Use a separate transient move descriptor without mutating dex/learned slots. Exact first effect: BP100, Physical Normal, priority0, non-contact, ordinary accuracy bypass, normal immunity/redirection/Substitute/semi-invulnerability; personal Protect quarter damage minimum1 only if otherwise effective. Test actual damage and relevant guard/ability controls.

Ordinary pre-action prevention consumes no source PP or Z use; once begun, debit one source PP even against Pressure and spend Z before effect. Immunity/protection/no target after beginning still spend. No crystal debit. Whole-turn failure restores effects/resources/RNG/messages.

Use existing complete-turn action consumers and meaningful side/target/PP/negative tests; preserve regular moves, items, rewards and Tera. Durable integration/public acceptance are dependent gates, not enabled by this issue alone.

implementation_issues.title: [Items][P3] Persist Z declarations and integrate battle mechanic budgets
implementation_issues.scope: Implement the versioned team Z ledger, bound queued action and complete-turn rollback/end/rebuild contract; no transformations or schema/live operations.
criteria: Persist team z_used and bound pending MOVE identity/source slot+ID/PP/target/crystal for both sides/full roster. Rebuild before/after activation repeatedly without replay, recharge, source-slot replacement or dex inference.
Missing legacy data defaults unused only without prior-use evidence; corrupted/conflicting/unbound declarations fail closed through recovery. Old ordinary moves remain ordinary despite held crystals.

Tera/Mega/Z budgets separate; same-actor active/pending conflicts reject both orders, different eligible allies may use different mechanics together. Preserve #715 held-crystal Tera rejection. No dependency on shipping the entire Mega system; exercise present Tera and provide integration seam for #785.

Fault after PP/damage, after another actor's move, checkpoint write and end/retry: full runtime/SQL/RNG/messages/actions roll back. Switch/faint/revive/reconnect retain used budget; end/flee/concede/abort clears only on committed ending. New battle alone resets.

Disposable PostgreSQL session/checkpoint tests plus existing Tera/Primal/medicine/capture/progression regressions pass. Keep public command gated on acceptance; do not implement Ultra Burst or enable metadata-only pairs.

implementation_issues.scope: Register proposed +zmove [actor] <active move slot or full name>=<target> only for Normalium Z/Tackle after private gates. Provide discovery and optional single-offer Counter.
criteria: No-argument discovery queues nothing; exact gapped slot/full-name and ordinary singles/doubles actor/target selection queues one MOVE, no second +attack. Wrong owner/stale menus/unsupported pairs/invalid targets spend no action, PP, use or item.

Normal shop recipe: Normalium Z only, selected PF2 price10000/finite stock1/no automatic refill; deliberate public hub/return exit, duplicate prevention and no running-world population. Use actual +store Buy menu, bag/itemdex and +hold before battle.

Walk ordinary acquire->equip->command->real full-turn damage/PP/used budget->switch/repeated checkpoint->end->return crystal in singles and both doubles sides/current Fusion. Include Protect/immunity/prevention, side contention, no-effect/funds/stock/rollback controls and unchanged reusable ownership.

Publish source/move/item allowlist and help with only accepted route. Run focused effects, disposable PostgreSQL command/session/commerce cases and mandatory three-order gate. Separate local proof from released live #782 and configured supply #781.

implementation_issues.title: [Items][P3] Accept bounded Z status boosts and self-healing effects
implementation_issues.scope: Select at most six existing source moves with simple zMove boost, heal or clearnegativeboost metadata, name them in a reviewed matrix before code, and implement only that list.
criteria: Freeze source move/crystal/holder, exact pre-base-effect Z bonus order, boost caps/HP and failure/prevention/PP rules from primary mechanics. No blanket support for all zMove metadata or contest stats.

criteria: Specify each source/crystal/native holder and exact effect/order/duration; replacement healing is slot-bound across switching/rebuild, redirect follows actual targeting, crit uses real damage and Curse branches by reviewed current type. No broad battle rewrite.
